finding: camera_preservation in scoreFromPixels() is computed as clampScore(min(horizontal_gradient/2.2, 48) + panEnergy*1200 + cameraEnergy*400 + 32), where panEnergy/cameraEnergy come directly from the UNFLOORED camera_velocity[0]/mean(camera_velocity) read from exports/source_video_dna/camera-behavior-dna/{SOURCE}.json.
